experiences.title: Front-end Developer at Chartix
experiences.description: My journey with Chartix began in September 2025 and marked a unique turning point in my career. Getting involved in developing websites and applications focused on financial market analysis and monitoring gave me a broader and more professional perspective on front-end development. It also allowed me to work with a wider range of tools and technologies. The experience was both challenging and inspiring.

experiences.title: Full-Stack Developer at Medis Holding
experiences.description: I started my journey as a Full-Stack Developer in March 2023, working in a collaborative and fast-paced environment with challenging projects and talented teammates. Throughout my time there, I’ve actively contributed to both front-end and back-end development across cross-functional teams. This role has strengthened my technical expertise, improved my problem-solving skills, and deepened my understanding of the complete software development lifecycle.
